job.purpose: Even-cat coherence envelope separates deterministic Z rotation, leakage and physical memory loss

metrics.initial_state: normalized even memory cat times buffer vacuum
metrics.phase_definition: unwrapped atan2(<Y>,<X>); meaningful only where phase_valid
metrics.interpretation: unconditioned logical coherence and leakage, not switching rate or measurement fidelity
metrics.coherence_scope: reduced memory: includes entanglement with the buffer as well as information lost to the environment
metrics.dephasing_caution: coherence loss alone does not uniquely identify pure dephasing; compare memory-loss controls, leakage and switching separately
metrics.reference_note: Requires separate pointer trajectories and coherent-output assumptions; not computed here
